intent: Product top chrome: brand mark on the start, centered kit Input search, trailing actions. Not a page title. Not a sidebar.
useWhen: Persistent product shell top bar with logo, global search, and utility actions
A full-bleed header above the page, not the page’s title block
doNotUseWhen: Page title, subtitle, Breadcrumb, or in-page actions — use PageHeader
Closeable product side nav — use SideNav
Horizontal site destinations and dropdowns — use NavigationMenu
Command palette overlay — use Command; AppHeader search is a kit Input

title.note: Product name next to the mark. Not an h1. Page titles belong on PageHeader.

mark.note: Brand letter. Defaults to the first character of title. Same idea as SideNav mark. Not a branded SVG.

logo.note: Custom mark or wordmark ReactNode. Replaces the default letter mark. Consumers pass their own logo. Do not copy a file-specific brand mark into the kit.

search.note: Renders a centered kit Input. Hide only when the shell has no global search.

searchValue.note: controlled. When set, pair with onSearch.

searchShortcut.note: Decorative Input end slot, e.g. ⌘K. Not a keybinding.

searchId.note: Passed to kit Input. Generated when omitted.

actions.note: kit Buttons. At most one primary. Do not put an assistant/Copilot CTA in the kit.

start.note: Replaces the start region (default: brand mark or logo, then title). title still names the header landmark. In AppShellPattern with a props header, start also replaces the Menu Button the shell injects as logo: put AppShellPattern.MenuButton inside your start.

center.note: Replaces the center region (default: the search Input when search is true). null leaves the center empty. Stacks under start and end in narrow containers, like search.

end.note: Replaces the end region (default: actions). Rendered in a group labelled Actions. At most one primary Button.

ariaLabel.note: header label. Defaults to title, then Application.

radius.note: Bar corners. none is a flush full-bleed bar. md is radius-surface-md for an inset floating bar.

compose.note: Building blocks for a header you arrange yourself. <AppHeader …/> is the preset built from them; output identical. Also exported as AppHeaderRoot, AppHeaderBrand, AppHeaderMark, AppHeaderTitle, AppHeaderSearch, AppHeaderCenter, AppHeaderSpacer, AppHeaderActions.
nesting: AppHeader.Root holds, in order: one AppHeader.Brand (start), at most one of AppHeader.Search / AppHeader.Center / AppHeader.Spacer (center), one AppHeader.Actions (end)
AppHeader.Brand children follow the brand cell: AppHeader.Title, then optional kit components (Badge, Select, DropdownMenu)
AppHeader.Mark goes in a logo slot (Brand logo, AppShellPattern.MenuButton children); Brand renders it itself from mark
Without a center block the bar uses two columns (start, end), as with search={false}

props.ariaLabel: Landmark label. Default Application. Pass the product name.

AppHeader.Root.note: Owns the landmark, the container query (stack below 38rem) and the bar grid. data-search="false" forces two columns; otherwise CSS :has() picks two columns when there is no center block.

props.mark: Brand letter in the rail-width cell
props.logo: ReactNode in the rail-width cell; replaces the letter. AppShellPattern.MenuButton goes here in a built shell header.
props.children: After the brand cell, e.g. AppHeader.Title

AppHeader.Brand.note: Start column. The brand cell (--appheader-brand-width, which follows --sidenav-width-collapsed) renders only when mark or logo is set; it centers the mark on the SideNav rail icons.

AppHeader.Mark.note: Letter mark on fill-brand, aria-hidden. One letter.

AppHeader.Title.note: Product name, ellipsis on overflow. Not a heading.

props.placeholder: Placeholder and accessible name. Default Search.
props.shortcut: Decorative hint in the Input end slot, e.g. ⌘K
props.ariaLabel: When the name should differ from placeholder

AppHeader.Search.note: Center column with the kit Input. Form-control passthrough: ref and native attributes reach the input.

AppHeader.Center.note: Center column for other kit content (ButtonGroup view switcher, Tabs). Stacks under the bar below 38rem, like Search.

AppHeader.Spacer.note: Empty, aria-hidden center column: keeps the three-column rhythm without search. Hidden below 38rem.

props.children: kit Buttons (tertiary sm icon buttons), Avatar. At most one primary.

AppHeader.Actions.note: End column. role=group with its label only when it has children.

compose.snippet:
<AppHeader.Root ariaLabel="Acme">
  <AppHeader.Brand mark="A">
    <AppHeader.Title>Acme</AppHeader.Title>
    <Badge tone="info" size="sm">Beta</Badge>
  </AppHeader.Brand>
  <AppHeader.Search placeholder="Search" shortcut="⌘K" onSearch={setQuery} />
  <AppHeader.Actions>
    <Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconStart="Bell" ariaLabel="Notifications" />
  </AppHeader.Actions>
</AppHeader.Root>
compose.copyIn: npx agentic-ds-kit add app-header copies ShellHeader (the preset built from these blocks) into components/chrome/app-header/.

cssVars.--appheader-padding-inline: Bar end padding and the stacked-search inset; the start stays 0 so the brand lines up with the SideNav rail (space-5 wide, space-4 in narrow containers)
cssVars.--appheader-gap: Gap between the start, center and end columns (space-4)
cssVars.--appheader-border-color: Bottom border colour, or the full border with radius md (border-faint)
cssVars.--appheader-brand-width: Column the default mark centers in (default: --sidenav-width-collapsed, then layout-sidebar-compact). Set --sidenav-width-collapsed on :root and the brand column follows; set this only to break the match
cssVars.--appheader-search-max-width: Max width of the center column (layout-rail)

requirements: header has aria-label from ariaLabel, title, or Application
Search is kit Input type=search with aria-label from searchPlaceholder
Mark sits in a layout-sidebar-compact slot, centered, so it shares the SideNav icon axis in layout-shell
Do not use h1 — page titles belong on PageHeader
At container 38rem, search stacks under brand and actions
Slots replace a region only; the header landmark and its aria-label stay
Built headers keep the landmark: AppHeader.Root is the only <header>; pass ariaLabel
AppHeader.Actions is a labelled group; AppHeader.Search keeps the Input's accessible name

doNot: Do not invent TopBar, SearchBar, Logo, Masthead, or AppBar cousins
Do not use PageHeader for product chrome
Do not leave a gap between AppHeader and SideNav — compose layout-shell over layout-app, both radius none
Do not pad the mark independently of layout-sidebar-compact — it must stay centered on SideNav icons
Do not use AppNav, SideNav, or NavigationMenu as a top bar with search
Do not bake a product logo SVG into the kit — use logo or mark
Do not add a Copilot, assistant, or sparkle CTA
Do not restyle kit Input internals
Do not put more than one primary Button in actions
Do not set component variables to raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps — use semantic tokens
Do not hand-roll a header bar, brand cell, or search field around the blocks — compose AppHeader.Root and its blocks
Do not put blocks outside AppHeader.Root, or more than one center block in one Root
Do not use h1–h6 for AppHeader.Title
snippet: <AppHeader title="Acme" mark="A" searchPlaceholder="Search" searchShortcut="⌘K" onSearch={setQuery} actions={<><Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconStart="Bell" ariaLabel="Notifications" /></>} />
